# Provenance register

Every ported algorithm, formula or file in this package gets an entry: where it came from, who wrote it, and under what licence. Nothing enters the package without an entry. This register is read before any licensing or sale (see ADR-0007 in the host repository's `docs/adr/`).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lexer | `src/lang/lexer.ts`, `tokens.ts`, `errors.ts`, `pythonisms.ts`, `limits.ts` | Written for this project. The indentation (INDENT/DEDENT) approach is the standard published technique used by Python's own tokenizer; no code was copied. Python is used only as a syntax reference. | Owned by the project owner (licence to be chosen) | 2026-10-09 | Needs verification by counsel only as part of the overall IP review |
| Parser, tree and formatter | `src/lang/parser.ts`, `ast.ts`, `format.ts` | Written for this project. ## Indicator kernel (S06)

Moved from the host's charting code into `src/kernel/` in S06. **How this was checked:** git history of every file below shows commits by AI sessions working for the owner (and small edits by the owner); no file carries a third-party licence header, copyright line or vendored source; the maths in each file is a published textbook definition. The move was verbatim: the only text changes were import paths, neutral wording for platform names in comments, and renaming two parameters called `window` (see SPEC and the S06 notes). Outputs of all 83 indicators were hashed before and after the move and are identical.

**Open for counsel:** many comments use another language's function names (for example `ta.atr`, `ta.linreg`) to say which behaviour a study matches; there is no script code in the files.  comments in the original files compared behaviour with a charting platform's built-in studies (for parity of defaults). That wording is now neutral. Whether matching another product's defaults is acceptable is part of the overall IP review, not decided here. **Needs verification.**
